# Type and method tables also keep encoding/json resolving: Pair's
# MarshalJSON and UnmarshalJSON are reached only through the interface
# assertion inside encoding/json. Dropping interface-reached methods
# breaks this verdict while reflect-only uses keep passing.
stdout '^reflect-ok$'
stdout '^json-ok$'
-- go.mod --
module example.com/wasmdeadreflect

go 1.27
-- main.go --
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"reflect"

	"logos/rt"
)

type Hidden struct {
	v int
}

func (Hidden) Answer() int {
	return 42
}

func hiddenAnswer() int {
	h := Hidden{v: 7}
	t := reflect.TypeOf(h)
	if t.NumMethod() != 1 {
		return -1
	}
	v := reflect.ValueOf(h)
	got := -2
	for i := 0; i < v.NumMethod(); i++ {
		out := v.Method(i).Call(nil)
		if len(out) == 1 && out[0].Kind() == reflect.Int {
			got = int(out[0].Int())
		}
	}
	return got
}

//go:wasmexport checkReflect
func checkReflect() int32 {
	if hiddenAnswer() != 42 {
		return rt.WasmError(errors.New("reflect missed dead method"))
	}
	return rt.WasmError(nil)
}

type Pair struct {
	A int
	B int
}

func (Pair) MarshalJSON() ([]byte, error) {
	return []byte(`{"pair":[3,4]}`), nil
}

func (p *Pair) UnmarshalJSON(b []byte) error {
	if string(b) != `{"pair":[3,4]}` {
		return errors.New("bad pair json")
	}
	p.A, p.B = 3, 4
	return nil
}

//go:wasmexport checkJson
func checkJson() int32 {
	b, err := json.Marshal(Pair{})
	if err != nil || string(b) != `{"pair":[3,4]}` {
		return rt.WasmError(errors.New("marshal mismatch"))
	}
	var p Pair
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"pair":[3,4]}`), &p); err != nil || p.A != 3 || p.B != 4 {
		return rt.WasmError(errors.New("unmarshal mismatch"))
	}
	return rt.WasmError(nil)
}

func main() {
	select {}
}
-- check.mjs --
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { resolve } from "node:path";
import { pathToFileURL } from "node:url";
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
const [wasmPath, loaderPath] = process.argv.slice(2);
const loader = await import(pathToFileURL(resolve(loaderPath)).href);
const { instance, exports } = await loader.instantiateLogos(readFileSync(wasmPath), {});
assert.equal(instance.exports.checkReflect(), 0);
assert.equal(instance.exports.checkJson(), 0);
exports.checkReflect();
exports.checkJson();
console.log("reflect-ok");
console.log("json-ok");
